models_evaluated: 15 representative MLLMs (proprietary and open-source; individual names not given in text)

links.outcome: Multi-turn multimodal diagnostic accuracy and reasoning quality of MLLMs on real-world cases
links.effect: Proprietary models had highest overall diagnostic accuracy, but the proportion of completely correct diagnoses remained limited across all models; reasoning quality showed considerable limitations.
links.quote: Results showed that proprietary models achieved the highest overall diagnostic accuracy, but the proportion of completely correct diagnoses remained limited across all models.

screen.reason: The study develops and evaluates ClinMM-Bench, a multi-turn multimodal clinical benchmark, testing 15 MLLMs on clinical diagnostic reasoning and error modes without evaluating a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
